result.instructions: Tools for AuftragsDesk, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are still open for ordering party ACME and when are they scheduled?"; "Show me all orders that changed since yesterday and their current status."; "Create a customer for the new site at Hauptstrasse 5 under our property manager, then open an order there for a boiler service.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AuftragsDesk data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run auftragsdesk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run auftragsdesk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run auftragsdesk_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. auftragsdesk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: auftragsdesk_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List field-service orders (Aufträge), newest change first. Filter by status, by last change time, by ordering party, by customer (job site) or by the ordering party's own order number. Needs the auftraege:lesen right. Open interface: GET /api/v1/auftraege.

status.description: Only orders with these statuses, for example ["OFFEN"].

changed_since.description: Only orders changed since this time, ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00+01:00.

ordering_party_id.description: Only records of this ordering party (Auftraggeber) id. Get ids from auftragsdesk_list_ordering_parties.

customer_id.description: Only orders of this customer (job site) id.

client_order_number.description: Only orders with this order number of the ordering party (auftragsnummerAuftraggeber).

tools.name: auftragsdesk_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by id: status and status text, description, ordering party, customer (job site), address, appointment, assigned staff and timestamps. Needs the auftraege:lesen right. Open interface: GET /api/v1/auftraege/{id}.

tools.name: auftragsdesk_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (Kunden, the job sites where work is done), sorted by name. Search by part of the name or filter by ordering party. Needs the kunden:lesen right. Open interface: GET /api/v1/kunden.

ordering_party_id.description: Only records of this ordering party (Auftraggeber) id. Get ids from auftragsdesk_list_ordering_parties.

tools.name: auftragsdesk_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer (job site) by id: name, address, contact person, phone and email, and the ordering party. Needs the kunden:lesen right. Open interface: GET /api/v1/kunden/{id}.

tools.name: auftragsdesk_list_ordering_parties
tools.title: List ordering parties
tools.description: List ordering parties (Auftraggeber): the businesses that send orders, for example a property management company. Sorted by name. Needs the auftraggeber:lesen right. Open interface: GET /api/v1/auftraggeber.

tools.name: auftragsdesk_get_ordering_party
tools.title: Get an ordering party
tools.description: Get one ordering party (Auftraggeber) by id: name, address, contact person, phone and email. Needs the auftraggeber:lesen right. Open interface: GET /api/v1/auftraggeber/{id}.

tools.name: auftragsdesk_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer (job site) for an ordering party. Required: ordering_party_id and name. Needs the kunden:schreiben right. Open interface: POST /api/v1/kunden.

ordering_party_id.description: Ordering party (Auftraggeber) id that the customer belongs to.

tools.name: auftragsdesk_create_order
tools.title: Create an order
tools.description: Create an order for a customer (job site). AuftragsDesk assigns the order number. Required: ordering_party_id, customer_id and description. With an appointment the order is scheduled at once. Needs the auftraege:schreiben right. Open interface: POST /api/v1/auftraege.

customer_id.description: Customer (job site) id; it must belong to the ordering party.

ticket_number.description: Ticket number of the ordering party.

client_order_number.description: Order number of the ordering party.

appointment.description: Appointment, ISO 8601 with offset, for example 2026-11-03T08:00:00+01:00.

tools.name: auftragsdesk_change_order_status
tools.title: Change an order's status
tools.description: Change the status of an order, for example TERMINIERT, IN_BEARBEITUNG, ABGESCHLOSSEN or STORNIERT. The same transition rules as in the app apply; a refused change returns HTTP 409. Needs the auftraege:schreiben right. Open interface: POST /api/v1/auftraege/{id}/status.

status.description: The new status key, for example ABGESCHLOSSEN.

reason.description: Reason, for example for a cancellation.
